channel.title: Dr. Yasas Sri Wickramasinghe
channel.description: Augmented reality research, teaching and writing from Dr. Yasas Sri Wickramasinghe.

item.title: NZGDC 2026 — Designing Shared Worlds Across Distance
item.description: I'm speaking at NZGDC 2026 (30 Sep – 3 Oct, Auckland) on "Designing Shared Worlds Across Distance: Lessons from Multiplayer AR Game Research" — real-time connections across distance, bridging places and people, and designing for presence, engagement and trust in multiplayer AR. 1 October 2026, 3:00–3:30 PM, NZ International Convention Centre, Auckland.

item.title: CODE with WIE 2026 — Workshop 01: Architecting the Augmented Tomorrow
item.description: Workshop 01 of CODE with WIE 2026, hosted by IEEE Women in Engineering Sri Lanka — exploring the technologies shaping the future and how innovation is transforming tomorrow's world, drawn from research in immersive technologies, software product engineering and game design. Online via Google Meet.

item.title: I Built a Free Website to Help Sri Lankan Drivers Save Thousands on Fuel
item.description: The story behind a free website built to help drivers in Sri Lanka find ways to save on fuel costs. Covers the motivation for the project and what it took to build and ship it.

item.title: Research Visit to Tohoku University — Building an NZ–Japan AR Collaboration
item.description: Prof. Rob Lindeman and I (HIT Lab NZ, University of Canterbury) visited the Interactive Content Design Lab at the Research Institute of Electrical Communication (RIEC), Tohoku University, Sendai, Japan. We presented our research on location-based augmented reality and immersive interaction, and explored a joint research project bridging New Zealand and Japan.

item.title: Selected for Falling Walls Lab Aotearoa New Zealand 2024
item.description: One of nineteen researchers and innovators chosen from across Aotearoa New Zealand and the Pacific to pitch a breakthrough idea in three minutes at Falling Walls Lab Aotearoa New Zealand 2024, organised by Royal Society Te Apārangi. Pitch: "Breaking the Wall of Loneliness through Play" — how location-based augmented reality games can bring people together and ease loneliness through shared experiences.

item.title: New Zealand Campervan Road Trip
item.description: A personal account of a campervan road trip through New Zealand. A change of pace from the technical writing — travel notes and reflections from the road.

item.title: Start a Money-Making Blog on Ghost
item.description: A practical walkthrough of starting a blog on the Ghost publishing platform with monetisation in mind. Covers the basics of setup and the choices that shape whether a blog can sustain itself.

item.title: Hand Tracking in Augmented Reality
item.description: An overview of how hand-tracking technology works in AR and why it matters for natural, controller-free interaction. Looks at the techniques and challenges behind tracking hand movement and gestures in real time.

item.title: Black Friday Gift Ideas for Him or Her in 2022
item.description: A lighter, seasonal piece with Black Friday gift ideas. A departure from the technical essays — practical, timely shopping suggestions.

item.title: ASML Chip Manufacturing: EUV Lithography & Computer Architecture
item.description: Explains ASML's role in modern chip manufacturing through extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography. Connects the physics of EUV to why it has become essential for producing today's most advanced processors.

item.title: GitHub Student Pack: Hidden Treasure for University Students
item.description: Highlights the GitHub Student Developer Pack and the free developer tools and services it unlocks for university students. Aimed at students who may not realise how much value the pack offers.

item.title: Computer Architect's View on Apple M1 Ultra Chip
item.description: A computer-architecture perspective on Apple's M1 Ultra chip, examining how its UltraFusion interconnect fuses two dies into a single unified processor. Considers what that design choice means for chip architecture more broadly.

item.title: Game Development with Augmented Reality
item.description: A look at what makes AR game development different from traditional game design, from spatial anchoring to real-world interaction. Covers the tools and considerations developers face building AR-native gameplay.

item.title: How Clean Coding Helps You Build Web Applications Quickly
item.description: Argues that clean, well-structured code speeds up development rather than slowing it down. Covers habits and conventions that keep a growing web application maintainable.

item.title: Creating a Design System Using React Material UI
item.description: Walks through building a consistent design system on top of React and Material UI. Covers component structure and design tokens as the foundation for a reusable UI library.

item.title: Free Virtual Queue for Your Business
item.description: Introduces a free virtual queueing tool built to help small businesses manage customer queues without hardware. Explains the problem it solves and how businesses can start using it.

item.title: Virtual Reality: A Secret Weapon to Boost Warehouse Efficiency
item.description: Explores how virtual reality can improve training, layout planning and operational efficiency in warehouse environments. Argues that VR offers a low-risk way to rehearse and refine warehouse processes before rollout.

item.title: Talking AR Game Design on the National Stage — NZGDC 2023
item.description: New Zealand Game Developers Conference, 2023. A panel of New Zealand augmented reality developers for the first-ever AR Game Dev Rant at NZGDC — a candid, fast-paced conversation about what it really takes to design and ship location-based AR experiences, alongside Evie, Melanie and Devi. (Exact date not published on-site; year only.)
